name: Verde River (Clarkdale - Cottonwood)
blurb: Short flatwater-to-riffle floats on the Verde River Greenway and Prescott NF access sites between Clarkdale and Camp Verde. Irrigation diversion dams, sweepers and strainers.

sections.takeOut: Dead Horse Ranch State Park River Day Use Area (Verde)
sections.notes: AZ State Parks Paddle Map 1: Mile 0.0 Tuzigoot Bridge to Mile 3.0 Dead Horse Ranch River Day Use Area. Two diversion dams: Hickey Ditch Diversion Dam (Mile 0.25) and Cottonwood Ditch Diversion Dam (Mile 0.8), scout on river left. Clarkdale: below the Cottonwood Ditch boaters 'will face many areas where portage is required'; the ditch can take the entire river at times. AZSP: watch for 'sleepers and strainers'.
sections.mapPendingReason: Tuzigoot River Access Point (Verde): No agency coordinate for the launch itself (Clarkdale page 403 to curl; text captured via WebFetch fallback; AZSP gives only the park-entrance coordinate). Dead Horse Ranch State Park River Day Use Area (Verde): No agency coordinate for the river day-use landing (the Dead Horse facility page's boat ramp is at the lagoons, not the river).

sections.notes: Prescott NF: 'a short, smooth water float from Black Canyon River Access Point'. AZ State Parks Paddle Map 3 table: Black Canyon (RM 23) 1.0 mile to Bignotti (RM 24). Do not continue below Bignotti: the water is 'generally too shallow and has too many obstacles for boating down river between Bignottie and White Bridge' (Prescott NF).

guideTimes.conditions: Guide lists 1 hour at low flow and 0.5 hour at medium flow for 1 mile. Numeric flow bands, craft and stops are not specified in this table.
guideTimes.sourceName: Arizona State Parks-hosted Verde River Paddle Map 3, page 3 (2013 guide)

putInAccess.operator: USDA Forest Service (Prescott NF, Verde RD)
putInAccess.sourceName: USFS EDW Recreation Opportunities, recareaid 67273 'Black Canyon Fishing Site' (Prescott NF page: 34.68495864, -111.9640087)
putInAccess.note: USFS EDW Recreation Opportunities, recareaid 67273 'Black Canyon Fishing Site' (Prescott NF page: 34.68495864, -111.9640087) is the managing agency's own point. Legal boating access: USDA Forest Service, Prescott NF: Black Canyon Fishing Site + Bignotti Picnic Site page (https://www.fs.usda.gov/r03/prescott/recreation/black-canyon-fishing-site): 'Black Canyon Fishing Site provides access to the Verde River where visitors enjoy fishing, picnicking, bird watching, canoeing, kayaking, and floating on inner tubes.' Bignotti page: 'Canoers and kayakers who put in for a short, smooth water float from Black Canyon River Access Point end their float trip here'. Imagery: Esri World Imagery z19 checked 2026-10-25 (research/raw/imagery/black_canyon_fishing_site_verde.png): Point is at the water's edge on the west bank beside the gravel parking area and the dirt turnaround, at a pool on the river. NHD flowline 17 m away.
putInAccess.bankSourceName: USGS NHD High Resolution flowline (flow-direction digitized) + Esri World Imagery
putInAccess.bankNote: Facing downstream (flow bearing ~127), the point is right of the NHD centreline (17 m).

takeOutAccess.operator: USDA Forest Service (Prescott NF, Verde RD)
takeOutAccess.sourceName: USFS EDW Recreation Opportunities, recareaid 67213 'Bignotti Picnic Site' (Prescott NF page: 34.67897869, -111.9541343)
takeOutAccess.note: USFS EDW Recreation Opportunities, recareaid 67213 'Bignotti Picnic Site' (Prescott NF page: 34.67897869, -111.9541343) is the managing agency's own point. Legal boating access: USDA Forest Service, Prescott NF: Bignotti Picnic Site (https://www.fs.usda.gov/r03/prescott/recreation/bignotti-picnic-site): 'Canoers and kayakers who put in for a short, smooth water float from Black Canyon River Access Point end their float trip here as the water is generally too shallow and has too many obstacles for boating down river between Bignottie and White Bridge which is 14 miles down river.' Imagery: Esri World Imagery z19 checked 2026-10-25 (research/raw/imagery/bignotti_picnic_site_verde.png): Point is on the wooded west bank at the end of the picnic-site road loop, about 10 m from open water. NHD flowline 1 m away.
takeOutAccess.bankSourceName: USGS NHD High Resolution flowline (flow-direction digitized) + Esri World Imagery
takeOutAccess.bankNote: Bank set from imagery: the NHD centreline is only 1 m away, so the computed side (river-left) is not reliable; facing downstream (flow bearing ~157) the point is on the river-right bank on imagery.
